page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The single-core performance is categorized as weak, with a Geekbench single-core score of 951.0 and a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1106.88. Single-threaded gzip compression is poor at 19.05 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks scale to average levels, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8312.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 23344.34. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 119.7 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 55.79 GB/sec for write operations, though the PassMark memory score itself falls into the weak category.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that do not demand high single-core clock speeds. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 14.04 GB/sec, database operations, and multi-threaded software compilation. It can also handle moderate LLM inference tasks for small to medium models, though text generation speeds are limited. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical cores and balanced resource density offer stable performance for parallelized enterprise applications, though the lack of local storage requires factoring in external storage performance.

Performance benchmarks indicate weak single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 951.0 and poor single-threaded gzip compression.
